title: 页面上的 action:button 不翻译按钮文字，传多语言对象还会让整页崩溃
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj

② fleet finding (class a) · Source: the card thread of cloud#4902 (PR objectstack-ai/cloud#4941), seen in the browser on cloud's current framework pin. Not measured on objectstack main.

**What happens.** A page-metadata node `action:button` renders `schema.label` as it is. A plain string label is never translated, and a label given as an inline locale map (`{ 'zh-CN': …, en: … }`) crashes the page with React's "Objects are not valid as a React child". `element:button` cannot name an `objectName` for a script action, so a page author has no way to put a localized button that runs a declared object action on a page.

Effect today: cloud's billing page (cloud#4902) had to use Markdown links to the environment's record page instead of running 调整席位 / 购买额度 / 管理订阅与发票 in one click.

**Expected.** `action:button` resolves its label the way other page nodes do (locale map or translation key), and never crashes on a locale map. Optional: if the action declares its own label, use it when the node gives none.

**Acceptance.** A test renders an `action:button` with a locale-map label in two locales and gets the right text, with no crash; a test that a string label still renders. Check on objectstack main first: the report is from cloud's pin.

Grading (proposed): `area:ux` · Bug · a page crash on a valid-looking label and no way to localize a page action button ⇒ p2. Evidence: measured in the browser on cloud's pin (thread report) + read.

Dedupe: searched `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue is:open` for "action:button label locale", "action button label not localized", "Objects are not valid as a React child label": none.
